title.narrative: Advancing Gender-Responsive Teacher Education in Uzbekistan: A Comprehensive Analysis and Action Plan

description.narrative: This work plan outlines a comprehensive analysis of gender integration in Uzbekistan's teacher education programs, aiming to foster a more inclusive and equitable education system. Aligned with UNESCO's commitment to gender equality and building on national Transforming Education Summit commitments, the study will assess current practices, knowledge, and attitudes towards gender issues in teacher training. Key activities include a desk review of policies and curricula, surveys, and stakeholder interviews. Deliverables encompass a comprehensive report, policy brief, and visual summaries, providing valuable insights for policymakers and educators. The initiative targets teacher educators and student teachers, with broader implications for the entire education system. By enhancing gender integration in teacher education, the project aims to create a more gender-responsive system, empowering educators to promote equality in classrooms. This contributes to improved learning outcomes and progress towards Sustainable Development Goals 4 and 5.
